datasets.label: Horálek optical
datasets.description: Visible-light colors from Petr Horálek's NOIRLab wide-field photograph, painted onto the shared image-fitted SMC emission model. Its broad envelope follows the VMC-constrained ellipsoid shape hypothesis, not measured gas depth.
